confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Krakow price levels, not from live menus, listings or booking pages. Restaurant and coffee anchors are the more reliable; July hostel and hotel rates are peak-season guesses and least certain. FX came from a search summary citing the RBA exchange-rates page; the page itself was not directly confirmed in this session.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general price levels in mid-sized Central European tourist cities such as Wroclaw, Gdansk and Prague, adjusted for Krakow's Old Town tourist premium and July demand.
